description: RETIRED in 2.1.228: forced the twoStageClassifier gate function to return true. The gate JS is gone (bytecode build); the config parameter's default value is encoded in bytecode instructions, not patchable text.
note: Searched 2.1.228 active dump: tengu_auto_mode_config (4 pooled parameter-definition copies at ~48187952/48190040/48192088/48208896) and twoStageClassifier (1 copy at ~48190408) exist only as Statsig DynamicConfig schema constants; the 'default' values sit in adjacent bytecode (9f-prefixed instructions), and no env-var or bundled fallback config overrides it. Forcing the gate would require bytecode editing, which this patch format cannot express safely. Auto-mode classifier verdicts are instead neutralized at the prompt level by patch 33.
